label: Mandate v6 (prereg-v6): v5 strategy plus a pre-registered recession overlay; designed in a session that had seen the 2005-2026 data, so a retrospective portfolio evaluation, not an untouched test.

overlay.warning: 10y minus 3m T-bill (bond-equivalent) monthly mean < 0 in any of the last 24 months
overlay.confirmation: SPY month-end close < mean of last 12 month-end closes
overlay.action: SPY and XLE halved, freed weight held as cash at 0%
overlay.exit: first month-end with SPY month-end close > its 12-month mean

departures_from_v5_evaluation: cash is held while the overlay is ON (C1 allows ETF weights summing below 1, the rest cash at 0%)
C2 and C3 use the latest effective target including any cash
forecasts and C4 use the v6 path's own daily returns, with the v6 strategy hash on every row
